objective: Review #60: `git diff 61b3d00..bea4ae7` (server-agent round 1 rebased as cc25961, plus coordinator fixup bea4ae7 that imports the contract types) against FR-29, FR-28, NFR-5, NFR-15, IR-10, IR-7 and the contract in packages/chess-core/src/api.ts (DailyStats doc comment). contract:
FR-29: GET /ops/daily-stats returns counts for a day: games started, tutor replies, tutor latency p50 and p95, errors by category, and Claude spend from the usage ledger (NFR-5), with demo usage reported separately (FR-28). It requires a shared secret (IR-10).
NFR-15: anything exposed for the dashboard holds versions and counts only: no log lines, no PGN or FEN, no chat text, nothing a player typed.
Coordinator rules given to the spoke: Bearer OPS_STATS_TOKEN, timingSafeEqual on equal-length buffers; unset/blank -> 404 JSON; missing/wrong -> 401; date UTC YYYY-MM-DD, default yesterday, malformed/future -> 400; schema v3->v4 adds a ledger table idempotently; one row per finished tutor ask (dropped replies included) and per bot failure; ledger write failure logged, game carries on; spend = tokens x config/models.json pricingPerMTok (input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite)/1e6, 4 decimals; unknown model -> 0 spend + one warning; nearest-rank rank = ceil(p*n).
Decided, do not re-report: tutorReplies counts validated replies even when dropped (api.ts doc updated in 61b3d00). The route returns 503 when no ledger is configured (only test wrappers).
Gate on bea4ae7 (coordinator): pnpm test 54 files, 1300 passed; typecheck clean.
Read with git diff / git show <sha>:<path>; you start in a worktree at bea4ae7.
